svg.title: Harsha — Field Notes Active
svg.desc: Technical profile README for Harsha, an AIML undergraduate who builds systems, experiments with machine learning, graphics, CLI tooling, automation and operating systems.

g.text: A person who builds things to understand them — then breaks them to understand them better.
Graphics and vector work that outgrew a curiosity
Distributed systems, because one machine was not enough
build the smallest version of it
Where machine learning ends and systems engineering begins.
How schedulers decide what deserves to run next.
Why some abstractions hold — and others leak immediately.
AIML UNDERGRAD · COURSEWORK GATHERS DUST; EXPERIMENTS DO NOT.
